description:
Lim Yuju, who had never lost first place in her life.
After entering university, the first person to stand in her way was Kang Doyun, a popular student from the business administration department, who possessed both handsome looks and excellent grades.

Unlike herself, who studies incredibly hard, Senior Kang Doyun seems to play every day but always surpasses her.

Yuju steadily builds up inferiority complex and jealousy towards him.

Then one day, she accidentally witnesses an unbelievable scene in the library reading room.

Senior Kang Doyun, sitting in the very seat she always studied in, a spot more familiar to her than anyone else,  
Engaging in an obscene act by himself.

It turns out that the perfect senior, loved by everyone,  
Was actually a total pervert secretly harboring strange desires?!
